name: Ight Imma Head Out
look: White space for a caption sits above a cartoon still. SpongeBob, with half-closed eyes, leans forward to get up from an orange armchair set on a life ring inside his pineapple house, beside a round porthole door. Bold text at the bottom reads IGHT IMMA HEAD OUT.
use: Used to bail out of a situation. The caption describes something boring, awkward, stressful or cringe, and SpongeBob rising from his chair with the printed line shows the decision to leave immediately.
slots: caption in the white space above: the situation worth leaving
examples: When the meeting invite says "quick sync" but it's booked for two hours
When my friends start planning a 6 a.m. hike
describe: spongebob getting up from his chair to leave
spongebob in an armchair saying he is about to head out
cartoon sponge standing up from a recliner to exit
spongebob leaving the room when things get awkward
yellow sponge in his pineapple house getting out of his seat
origin: A still of SpongeBob getting up from his armchair in SpongeBob SquarePants; the "Ight imma head out" caption was added by fans.
